notes: Scenarios are synthetic and expected actions are predefined.
Feasible options are calculated by the application scheduler.
No study plans or application records are changed.
The application validates AI proposals before returning them.
Rejected initial decisions appear as failed attempts.
Explanation repair can make one additional AI request.
Raw model outputs and repair counts are not recorded.
Final explanations are generated by application code.
Explanation scoring checks the final application explanation.
It does not measure raw model explanation accuracy.
Checks cover template claims, dates, limits, and days saved.
The checks are not general natural-language verification.
Accepted-proposal rate is not raw model safety accuracy.
Action accuracy includes failures in its denominator.
All-attempt explanation consistency includes failures.
Accepted-proposal explanation consistency excludes failures.
Preference alignment includes preference-applicable failures.
Preference checks are benchmark rubrics, not universal optima.
Lighter-workload cases prefer the lowest feasible daily limit.
Finish-sooner cases prefer earliest finish, then lowest limit.
Latency includes explanation repair and factual rendering.
Option generation and evaluation scoring are outside latency.
Memory readings describe the entire local Python process.
Memory readings are before/after samples, not peak usage.
Attempts run sequentially in the same process.
Exit status reports request failures; inspect quality metrics.
